title: xfr-engine: deterministic financial engine for the shadow price of credit
description: Python implementation of the mathematical core of the manuscript 'The Shadow Price of Credit: An Explainable-AI Decision-Support System for Corporate Recapitalization under Credit-Line Withdrawal' (M. de Alencar Netto, 2026): cash and debt identities, minimum-equity linear program (HiGHS), credit-to-equity substitution index (CES/ISC), directional shadow price of credit capacity, infeasibility diagnosis and automated consistency tests. Version 0.3.0 adds the institutional layer of the companion paper on interest on equity (JCP), credit withdrawal and equity substitution in Brazil and the United States: corporate tax, deductible interest with cap, loss-offset limit, JCP with TJLP base and ceilings, withholding, interest-rate channel and DIP financing, as a mixed-integer LP; the net cost of substitution (CLS); Experiment I (institutional comparative statics, channel decomposition, DIP sensitivity) and 36 automated tests. Version 0.4.0 adds the Stage 2 firm-quarter panel of listed Brazilian (CVM) and U.S. (SEC) non-financial companies and runs Experiment I on it, with same-firm comparison under both jurisdictions; results measure solver sensitivity to parameterized scenarios and do not validate actual credit withdrawals. Version 0.4.1 fixes a double count of JCP in the tax channel of the synthetic decomposition and adds a script for all panel sensitivities, a sensitivity with pre-existing interest deductible, the no-DIP channel split, the isolated interest shield and the JCP effect by loss state; it also fixes the MILP solution: HiGHS false optima with presolve, the default MIP gap and solutions that used the feasibility tolerance in the big-M rows are now handled by solving with and without presolve at zero gap and polishing every candidate to integral binaries, which matches an exact enumeration of the binary branches within 1e-6. The panel and all sensitivities were rerun; values in the v0.4.0 tables change by at most one unit in the last printed digit and the verdicts are unchanged.
